In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
